setting: Nia, Tomas and Kofi keep the watering rota for Alder Court community garden, and use this group to swap slots. Tex is in the group with the rota note, the shared calendar and the web. Tex speaks when someone asks it or when it truly helps; most of the chat is the three of them.
title: The garden rota

must: list each slot with its person, short

msgs.text: morning. tex what does watering look like this week
Mon and Wed evenings are Kofi's. Thu 8am is Tomas's, Sat 8am is Nia's, and Sun is Kofi's again.
ta. the back hose is leaking again
i'll look at it thurs when i'm there
did anyone else get the council water notice
yeah just the usual flushing, no action
[pic: a tomato the size of a fist]
from the bed by the gate. i'll bring some saturday
bring the big ones, not the sad ones

must: name the gap and ask who covers it
never: hand saturday to the rest of the crew
